## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite flow still accepts passwords shorter than twelve characters, so the new minimum is only partly enforced; this is the one open defect and it should be fixed.

## Changes
This pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py`, and updates both boundary tests to check 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve too — The invite path still accepts an 8-character password such as `"x" * 8`, because `app/invite.py:1` still sets `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while signup and reset now require 12. The PR body says "This raises the minimum in the password validators", but this third validator was left at 8. — Users created through invites can set passwords of 8 to 11 characters, which breaks the twelve-character security policy. — Fix: Set `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12` at `app/invite.py:1` and update the parametrization and expected values in `tests/test_invite.py:6` to match `tests/test_signup.py`.
